selection: Up to 64 .slp members per source, smallest SHA-1 of UTF-8 member path; selection independent of codec measurements. Deduplicate by SHA-256 against all 521 development inputs and across selected members. No replacement of excluded duplicates.
use: Final validation only after candidate and training profile are frozen; no tuning on these results. If a candidate fails, retire this set as validation data and reserve new source collections.
metrics: At default level 3, one replay per archive, arithmetic mean elapsed time over 9 randomized interleaved repeats after warmup, one and eight independent workers. Check all three user alternatives and report both throughput and elapsed-time changes.
limitations: Source archives were previously decoded/recompressed for migration, but these samples are excluded from current tuning and profile training. Source-group separation reduces but cannot eliminate related-game leakage.
